# dsh-reference-render
Domain-neutral **structured reference rendering** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations: `label`
becomes an inline chip — dot/bar/icon decorations on either side, hover preview, click-to-open. The
renderer understands **no business domain**; content comes from other plugins through frozen contrac
derer understands **no business domain**; content comes from other plugins through frozen contracts.

## Usage
**Emit** — a plain GFM link becomes a chip; without the plugin it degrades to an ordinary link:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Decorate** — a content plugin claims a reference and supplies dot/bar/icon decorations for either
side, up to 3 per side. An icon without a color follows the text color; `mode: 'image'` renders an o
riginal-color ``. Unclaimed references stay plain chips — hover and click are no-ops.

oving the plugin leaves the host unchanged.
